ABOUT VILA VENTO
</h5> <div  style="font-size:20px" class="o-text  u-ml-15__1366 u-ml-5__768"><p>Vila Vento was born from a dream of a local kitesurfer Alexandre<br />
Kuzolitz and his greek wife Anna Tsalikian, who back in 2016 started<br />
building the first kite house as the perfect getaway for the family to<br />
live and kite in Maranhao. This is our dream home .</p> <p><br />
We are a boutique hotel beautifully situated in front of Atins beach.<br />
Here you have the privilege to launch and land your kite right at our<br />
yard.</p> </div> </div> </div> </div> </section> <section class="c-section" data-scroll-section> <div class="o-container"> <div class="o-layout -mobile-reverse"> <div class="o-layout_item u-1/2@from-small"> <div class="c-overlay-img"> <div class="o-image_wrapper"> <div class="o-image is-inview" data-scroll> <img alt="" class="lazyload blur-up" data-src="https://www.vilavento.com/SPages/home_files/images/DJI_0548 (1).JPG" src="https://www.vilavento.com/SPages/home_files/images/DJI_0548 (1).JPG"> </div> </div> </div> </div> <div class="o-layout_item u-1/2@from-small" data-scroll> <h5 style="font-size: 60px;"class="c-banner-title__top u-ml-10__1366 u-ml-5__768 u-mt-5__360 u-mt-0__768 u-mt-10__1366">OUR PASSION</h5> <p class="o-text  u-ml-15__1366 u-ml-5__768">
We are passionate to host and share the wonders of Lencois
and provide our guests with great activities and unforgettable
experiences.
</p> <p class="o-text  u-ml-15__1366 u-ml-5__768 u-mb-3__360 u-mb-0__768">
Please feel free to contact us for a great time in this natural
wonder of Brazil’s northeast coast.
